name: font_manager_remove_path

provenance.source: Exact .139 uikit font_manager decompilation; the manager hangs off *0x200bd1e8+28 and its registered-path list uses payload size at +24 and head at +28.

notes: Unlinks one registered-path entry from the font manager's registry after validating the handle is in the list, then frees its name, its path and the node itself. Takes the node handle, not a family name. UI owner thread only, never under the interrupt lock. Affects only font wrappers created afterwards. Device probe pending.
